summary: Iteration 3 backend regression after refactor (no new features). Ran the full pytest suite — 15 regression tests in backend_test.py + 11 premium/Stripe tests in test_premium.py = 26/26 PASSED in 30.99s against the live preview URL. Verified the extracted Stripe helper `_make_stripe_checkout(request)` is used in all 3 sites (create_checkout, payment_status, stripe_webhook) and behavior is preserved end-to-end.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iter-2: still makes a Stripe API call + DB write on every poll even when tx.payment_status is already 'paid'. Refactor did not change this — consider short-circuit.
Carry-over: still cannot be unit-tested without a real Stripe signature; idempotency via payment_transactions.premium_granted only validated by code review.

critical_code_review_comments: _make_stripe_checkout (server.py:653) is correctly DRY-extracted and consumed by create_checkout (669), get_payment_status (764), and stripe_webhook (792). Single source of truth for STRIPE_API_KEY + webhook_url construction.
server.py is still ~837 lines — recommend splitting into routes/{auth,chat,payments,reminders,guides}.py for maintainability. This was flagged in iter-2 and has not changed.
Refactor changed no business logic: PREMIUM_PACKAGES, _grant_premium_if_paid, monthly_ai_usage, is_premium, and FREE_MONTHLY_AI_LIMIT (10) all behave identically (verified by 26/26 regression).

Frontend split (QuickActions, RemindersSection, RecentChats, FeaturedGuides, ChatHeader, ChatEmptyState, MessageBubble, ChatInput, MobileMenu) and AuthContext useMemo/useCallback were NOT tested (backend-only request). Recommend a frontend pass before release to catch missing prop wiring or stale closure bugs introduced by useMemo dependency arrays.
test_credentials: All tests provision ephemeral TEST_-prefixed users + sessions directly in MongoDB (test_database) and tear them down in finally blocks. backend_test.py still uses the long-lived TEST_SESSION_TOKEN env var (default token present and valid). No production data touched.
seed_data_creation: Per-test: user + session, plus optional pre-seeded chat_messages (n_user_msgs param) and premium_until ISO future date. All deleted on cleanup (users, user_sessions, chat_messages, chat_sessions, payment_transactions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor iteration confirmed clean. backend_test.py (15) + test_premium.py (11) both green. Stripe helper extraction verified by code grep AND by passing checkout + status tests. Frontend component splits and AuthContext memoization remain UNTESTED — next agent should run a Playwright pass on the dashboard (QuickActions/Reminders/RecentChats/FeaturedGuides), chat page (Header/EmptyState/MessageBubble/Input), and MobileMenu, paying attention to: (a) reminder create/list/delete still wires through RemindersSection, (b) chat input still focuses + clears, (c) AuthContext logout still triggers a re-render (useCallback dep array), (d) mobile burger opens MobileMenu and closes on route change.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Refactor preserved behavior. The extracted helper is a simple builder that returns `StripeCheckout(api_key=STRIPE_API_KEY, webhook_url=f'{origin}/api/webhook/stripe')` so all three call sites get identical configuration; the 26-test regression including a real Stripe-sandbox checkout (test_checkout_success_creates_transaction) and a status poll proves the helper is wired correctly.
